children: Overview
U.S. fintech-focused bank's Q3 diluted EPS rose yr/yr, driven by fintech fee growth
Net income for Q3 of $62.8 mln
Company repurchased $50 mln in shares, representing 2% of outstanding stock
Outlook
The Bancorp maintains 2026 Core EPS guidance at $5.95-$6.05
Company provides 2027 Core EPS baseline range of $7.00-$7.20
The Bancorp initiates preliminary 2028 Core EPS guidance of $8.00-$8.20
Result Drivers
FINTECH FEE GROWTH - Co said higher fintech fees were driven by increased volume with existing partners and products, and expansion of its fintech business
FINTECH LOAN GROWTH - Growth in fintech loans contributed to overall loan portfolio expansion, reflecting a strategic shift toward sponsored lending
EFFICIENCY INITIATIVES - Co cited productivity gains from restructuring and AI adoption as supporting future results
